title: Unit identity needs a nontrivial target
situation: The restricted unit expression x+(1-x)=1 and both equations x=0, 1-x=0 hold at the unique point of a one-element zero algebra because 1=0 there. Removing nontriviality invalidates the emptiness conclusion.
attempted_conclusion: Infer no point solely from the unit derivation and vanishing generators without nontriviality.

expected.reason: The zero algebra satisfies the unit derivation and equations at a point while 1=0.
